detaileddescription.para:
Tests that GPU operations gracefully fall back to CPU when:
CUDA memory allocation fails
CUDA memory copy operations fail
Kernel execution times out (exceeds SLA)
Other GPU operations encounter errors

Since we cannot directly inject CUDA errors in tests, we verify fallback behavior by:
Using force_cpu mode to simulate CPU-only operation
Running on systems without CUDA to trigger automatic fallback
Verifying stats reflect correct fallback behavior
Verifying results are still correct despite fallback
